caseName: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Co. v. Richardson
caseNameFull: The Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Company, in Error v. C. W. Richardson
disposition: Motion to dismiss or affirm submitted February 27,1911.
summary: Error to the Court of Civil Appeals for the Fifth Supreme Judicial District of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. Joseph W. Bailey and Mr. Rice Maxey for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs.

Louisville & Nashville Railroad Company v. Melton, 218 U. S. 36; Mobile, Jackson & Kansas City Railroad Company v. Turnipseed, Administrator, &c., 219 U. S. 35. Mr. Cecil H. Smith, Mr.. James Hagerman and Mr. Joseph M. Bryson for the plaintiff in error.
